name: Glasses in front of a shelf (Tobii Pro Lab export)
provider: Tobii Pro Glasses 2 via Tobii Pro Lab data export
description: 4 simulated shoppers wear Tobii Pro Glasses 2 (50 samples per second) in front of a cereal shelf and do three marked tasks: look around freely, find the cheapest product, choose one to buy. The files are laid out like a Tobii Pro Lab data export with Czech number format (decimal commas): eye-tracker, gyroscope and accelerometer rows interleaved, markers in the Event column, gaze mapped onto the snapshot “Shelf” and one “AOI hit” column per product.
